Oracle Stock Analysis: Bullish Bias Meets Earnings Week Test

Oracle stock enters earnings week at a critical juncture. The daily trend remains bullish, but hourly momentum has broken down, with the stock closing June 8 near $211.82. Short-term sellers now control the tape despite the intact daily structure. The next move will be catalytic, not technical.
